newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EDP soars, reflects fair value.
newsitem.headline: EDP soars, reflects fair value.

text.p: Shares in state utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal soared on its first day of trade on Lisbon bourse after its partial privatisation, reflecting a fair value for the stock, analysts said.

They said the share had received a discount at its privatisation and that a range around 3,150 escudos reached by midsession reflected the present fundamental value of Portugal's dominant electricity provider.
"It's nice to see a share go to a fair value," said James Harrison of Lisbon broker Midas, who had expected EDP to hit 3,150 escudos.
EDP stood at 3,175 escudos, at the upper end of analysts' expectations, compared with a privatisation price of 2,250 escudos, in volume of 1,941,365 shares at 1145 GMT.
The government earned over $2.0 billion on Monday from the sale of a 30 percent stake in EDP.
